name: DVS Gesture
description: The IBM DVS Gesture dataset contains event-based recordings of people performing 29 gesture classes, captured with a Dynamic Vision Sensor (DVS). The recordings provide spatiotemporal event streams for research in gesture recognition and neuromorphic vision.
citation: Amir, A., et al. (2017). A Low Power, Fully Event-Based Gesture Recognition System. 2017 IEEE Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).
